__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource scraping the epub2pdf-api and epub2pdf-worker pods (see infra/k8s/10-api.yaml and infra/k8s/20-worker.yaml's prometheus.io/* scrape annotations).

title: EPUB→PDF Conversion Platform - Overview
description: Basic operational dashboard for packages/api + packages/worker. All queries use the actual Prometheus metric names exported by packages/worker/src/metrics.js and packages/api/src/routes/metrics.js, except the Queue Length panel - see its description and the notes panel at the top.

options.content:
**Assumptions baked into this dashboard** (see `infra/prometheus/alerts.yaml` for the same notes in more detail):
- Queries that need to tell the api and worker apart (they both export a `conversion_jobs_started_total` counter, with *different* meanings - submitted-via-API vs. picked-up-by-worker) filter on `job="epub2pdf-worker"` / `job="epub2pdf-api"`, matching the `app.kubernetes.io/name` pod labels + scrape annotations in `infra/k8s/`. Adjust panel queries if your Prometheus scrape config names jobs differently.
- **Queue Length panel: `queue_length` is not emitted by any service in this codebase as of this writing** (confirmed by reading `packages/worker/src/metrics.js` directly). It will show "No data" until that Gauge is added to the worker and exposed via its existing `/metrics` endpoint - see `infra/k8s/20-worker.yaml`'s ScaledObject comment for the recommended implementation (poll BullMQ's `Queue#getJobCounts()`). Note also: `docs/RISKS.md` and `docs/adr/0002-queue-technology.md` cite the source spec's name for this same metric as `redis_queue_length` - reconcile to one canonical name when it's implemented, and update this panel's query to match.

panels.title: Job Throughput
panels.description: conversion_jobs_started_total (worker-side: jobs picked up off the queue), conversion_jobs_processed_total and conversion_jobs_failed_total, all packages/worker/src/metrics.js counters, as a per-second rate.

panels.title: Conversion Duration (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Quantiles derived from conversion_jobs_duration_seconds (packages/worker/src/metrics.js Histogram; buckets: 1, 5, 15, 30, 45, 60, 120, 300, 600, 1200 seconds - the max bucket lines up with CALIBRE_TIMEOUT_MS=20min in packages/shared/src/constants.js).

panels.title: Queue Length
panels.description: NOT YET WIRED UP: queue_length is not exported by packages/worker/src/metrics.js as of this writing - this panel will show "No data" until that Gauge is added (see the notes panel above and infra/k8s/20-worker.yaml). Alert threshold (1000) shown as a reference line once data exists.

panels.title: Active Jobs
panels.description: Sum of active_jobs (packages/worker/src/metrics.js Gauge) across all worker replicas - jobs currently mid-conversion right now.

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: conversion_jobs_failed_total / conversion_jobs_started_total (both scoped to job="epub2pdf-worker" - see the notes panel above for why). Same ratio as the HighConversionFailureRate alert in infra/prometheus/alerts.yaml, but over a shorter 5m window here for a more responsive graph; the alert itself evaluates over 1h.

panels.title: Engine Usage (chrome vs calibre)
panels.description: engine_usage_total (packages/worker/src/metrics.js Counter, labelled by engine) - useful context alongside failure rate, since RENDER_CHROME_FAILED vs RENDER_CALIBRE_FAILED usually have different root causes. Bonus panel, not one of the required five.

panels.title: API Request Duration (p95, by route)
panels.description: http_request_duration_seconds (packages/api/src/routes/metrics.js Histogram, labelled by method/route/status_code). Bonus panel, not one of the required five - included since it's a real exported metric and pairs naturally with the worker-side duration panel.
